lines.serbian: Četiri prijatelja putuju u vikendicu pored jezera.
lines.croatian: Četiri prijatelja putuju u vikendicu pored jezera.
lines.english: Four friends are travelling to a summer house by a lake.

lines.serbian: Vikendica je Nenadova, ali on tamo nije bio pet godina.
lines.croatian: Vikendica je Nenadova, ali on tamo nije bio pet godina.
lines.english: The summer house is Nenad's, but he hasn't been there for five years.

lines.serbian: Automobil je pun hrane i pića.
lines.croatian: Automobil je pun hrane i pića.
lines.english: The car is full of food and drink.

lines.serbian: Posle sat vremena još uvek voze.
lines.croatian: Nakon sat vremena još uvijek voze.
lines.english: An hour later they're still driving.

lines.serbian: Put je sve gori, a telefoni nemaju signal.
lines.croatian: Put je sve gori, a telefoni nemaju signal.
lines.english: The road keeps getting worse, and the phones have no signal.
At last they see a small wooden house.

lines.serbian: Nenad vadi ključ, ali ključ ne otvara vrata.
lines.croatian: Nenad vadi ključ, ali ključ ne otvara vrata.
lines.english: Nenad takes out the key, but it doesn't open the door.
Then the door opens from the inside.
An older man looks at them in surprise.

lines.serbian: – Ovo je moja vikendica! – kaže Nenad.
lines.croatian: – Ovo je moja vikendica! – kaže Nenad.
lines.english: "This is my summer house!" says Nenad.

lines.serbian: – Vaša je ona plava, iza šume.
lines.croatian: – Vaša je ona plava, iza šume.
lines.english: "Yours is the blue one, behind the woods."

lines.serbian: – Vi ste Nenad? Pet godina vas nisam video! Dođite na kafu.
lines.croatian: – Vi ste Nenad? Pet godina vas nisam vidio! Dođite na kavu.
lines.english: "You're Nenad? I haven't seen you for five years! Come and have a coffee."
